# Whaleora | Personal Safety

> Your Safety. Our Priority.

Whaleora is an Indian personal safety brand based in Mumbai, shipping across India. The brand focuses on practical, thoughtfully designed safety essentials for everyday preparedness.

## Product lineup

- **Personal SOS Alarm — ₹1,699:** Model AF-2004; 130dB alarm, pull-pin activation, Type-C (USB-C) rechargeable 130mAh lithium battery, ABS body, 28g, and dimensions 100 × 31 × 13.5mm. Supplier-listed charging time is about 90 minutes; alarm duration about 70 minutes; steady lighting about 240 minutes; flashing light about 300 minutes. The light button cycles through steady light, strobe, then off.
- **Pepper Spray — ₹499:** 50ml Oleoresin Capsicum (OC) stream canister with a protective locking cap and a stated range of up to 7 feet. Follow the product instructions and check local, venue, and travel rules before carrying it.
- **Emergency Window Breaker — ₹599:** 92g vehicle escape tool with a spring-loaded tungsten strike point and concealed seatbelt cutter. Intended for suitable tempered side glass; it will not break a laminated windscreen. Store securely within reach in the vehicle, not on a keyring.
- **Survival Whistle — ₹299:** 120dB dual-tube, breath-powered aluminium whistle. Battery-free and suitable for attachment to a bag or keyring.

## Choosing a tool

Each product has a different purpose. The SOS Alarm and Survival Whistle are acoustic attention-getting tools; pepper spray is intended to help create distance so the user can move toward safety; the Window Breaker is a vehicle emergency escape tool. No safety tool guarantees an outcome. Read the instructions and check applicable rules before use or travel.
